notes.subject: bel bilong yumi
notes.rationale: נפש em i win bilong laip, no bel; tasol Tok Pisin i usim bel long tingting na laik, olsem em i tok klostu

notes.subject: גאיונים
notes.rationale: Tok i kamap hia tasol long ol Psalm bilong go antap; ol man i tingting: ol man bikhet, o ol man ol i singaut long ol

notes.subject: לגאיונים
notes.rationale: Dispela tok i stap hia tasol long ol Tanakh (Ps 123:4 wantaim Ps 123:3 singaut)

translation: Planti tru bel bilong yumi i kamil pinis long mock bilong ol man i no gat wari, na long pasin bilong ol man i lukdaun long yumi, ol bikhet man.

tokens.gloss: ol man i no gat wari
pasin bilong ol man i lukdaun
